The current implementation does not appear to have any obvious leaks in the provided test cases. However, I want to create a more targeted test to verify that the credential is not leaked in any channel, especially considering the requirement that "the credential may never appear in returned values or keys, stdout, stderr, or logging, including nested debug structures and exception text."

Let me run an additional test case to check for potential credential leaks.
